time_origin: relative simulation time, t=0 uses exact original static positions
interval_semantics: Frame t records position/channel at t and movement during (t-10,t]; frame zero has zero distance/speed.
static_selection: first 30 rows in original source order, matching the static paper experiment
movement_model: Correlated random walk with full-segment building avoidance; 40-80 s moving / 20-40 s pauses for intermittent users.
profile_assignment: Building-contained source users are static. Among remaining users, seeded ID ranking selects exactly 10 intermittent and 10 continuous users; others are static.
bounds_policy: Preserve existing bounds except sides excluding source coordinates; extend those sides 5 m past the outermost source point.
channel_model: Unchanged upstream geometry/LOS/path-loss/SNR/CQI model, recomputed at every frame including t=0. Source signal columns are retained separately, not spliced into the new timeline.
user_identity: Persistent (Scenario,RX_ID); source ID, X/Y/Z at t=0, request and label preserved.
limitations: Position/request continuity does not imply static allocation or channel continuity; north has legacy channel discrepancies reported in static_initial_comparison.csv.
Four building-contained source users are retained as stationary. The inherited signal model is not a calibrated indoor penetration model.
Buildings constrain outdoor movement; roads, shorelines, land use and user-user collision avoidance are not modeled.
No special south-user-7 toward-BS modification is applied in this independent variant.
This package contains scenario inputs and maps only; existing paper service/control results are not results for these new inputs.
